hypotheses.M0_exact_composition: The all-attention recurrence matches independent autograd gradients at both edited positions to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.M1_near12_gradient_fidelity: The next-twelve attention program reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 in every source-layer and position-pair cell.
hypotheses.M2_near8_not_universal: The next-eight program fails the 0.90 median or 0.75 Q10 gradient gate in at least one cell.
hypotheses.M3_fixed_budget_finite_direction: A single prospective top-64 budget across both positions moves the joint-edit score positively on at least 90% of sites in every source-layer and position-pair cell.
hypotheses.M4_both_sources_are_used: The minority source receives at least 10% of the selected channels in the median cell for the exact selector.
hypotheses.M5_output_interaction_is_material: The median probability-space two-edit interaction norm is at least 5% of the joint-edit change norm.
hypotheses.M6_near12_retains_exact_effect: The next-twelve selector retains at least 80% of the exact-selector mean finite effect in every cell.
